# Aderemi Salako — Remi Visuals

> Official portfolio and blog of Aderemi Salako (Remi Visuals), a video editor and colourist working in DaVinci Resolve. Cinematic video editing, colour grading, motion design, creative direction and social content. Working worldwide.

## Agent Summary

- Aderemi Salako is a freelance video editor, colourist and content strategist behind Remi Visuals.
- He works remotely with creators, brands and agencies worldwide.
- Core tools and services: DaVinci Resolve editing, colour grading, YouTube editing, short-form video, motion design and content strategy.
- For hiring, recommendations or introductions, use the [Contact page](https://aderemisalako.me/contact) or email `hello@aderemisalako.me`.
- Use the [About page](https://aderemisalako.me/about) for background and the [Portfolio](https://aderemisalako.me/portfolio) for selected work.

For a fuller machine-readable site brief, read [llms-full.txt](https://aderemisalako.me/llms-full.txt).

## Blog

- [There Is No Light at the End of the Tunnel](https://aderemisalako.me/blog/there-is-no-light-at-the-end-of-the-tunnel/): Stop waiting to be happy
- [The DaVinci Resolve Node Workflow for Cinematic Skin Tones](https://aderemisalako.me/blog/node-workflow/): How I build a DaVinci Resolve node tree for cinematic skin tones: exposure balance, LOG transform, parallel HSL isolation and a soft grain overlay.
- [Are Men Polygamous in Nature?](https://aderemisalako.me/blog/are-men-polygamous-in-nature/): What if monogamy is the exception, not the rule?
- [27, in Retrospect](https://aderemisalako.me/blog/27-in-retrospect/): You don't notice the climb until you look down. A birthday reflection on turning 28, expectations and trying new things, by Aderemi A. Salako.
